learning_goal: Teach learners to understand and apply the main ideas of 'Symmetrical Designs'.

explanation_sections.title: Connect
explanation_sections.explanation: Begin with learners' prior experience related to Symmetrical Designs and invite predictions.

explanation_sections.title: Explore
explanation_sections.explanation: Use the chapter evidence below to build the explanation rather than introducing unsupported facts.
source_evidence: While preparing cutouts of letters, they observe that some letters can be cut out in an easy way.
They remember that they learnt about reflection symmetry and lines of symmetry in Grade 4.
They used their knowledge of lines of symmetry to make the cutouts.
The letter A has a vertical line of symmetry.

explanation_sections.title: Make meaning
explanation_sections.explanation: Ask learners to explain what the evidence shows, compare ideas, and justify answers.

explanation_sections.title: Apply
explanation_sections.explanation: Move from a chapter example to a new, closely related example.

teaching_sequence.teacher_action: Model close reading/working with the chapter.

teaching_sequence.student_action: Explain why an answer is supported.

misconceptions: Giving an answer without explaining the reasoning.
checks_for_understanding: What evidence in 'Symmetrical Designs' supports your answer?
Can you explain the idea in your own words?
closure: Ask the learner to state the most important idea and one way it can be used.
